objective: Port remaining dav1d C89 files into stb_avif.h to fix the internal AV1 decoder.

actions: Ported itx_1d_c89.c + itx_tmpl_c89.c: fixed-point integer transforms (DCT/ADST/FLIPADST/Identity 4/8/16/32) integrated
Fixed stb_av1_iclip/imin/imax scope issue: moved out of C89 guard to shared section
Fixed scan table scope: moved stb_av1_scan_4x4/8x8/16x16/32x32/scans to shared section
Both C89 and dav1d builds compile with 0 errors
history.outcome: Fixed-point integer transforms integrated. Both builds compile clean.

actions: Ported dequant_tables_c89.c: replaced simplified 8-bit DC/AC lookup tables with proper dav1d 3D table stb_av1_dq_tbl[3][256][2]
Updated stb_av1_get_dequant() to use bit_depth index (8/10/12-bit support)
Completed truncated 12-bit dequant table (was missing 252 entries)
history.outcome: Proper dequant tables integrated with full 8/10/12-bit support.

actions: Added AV1-spec dequant shift: dq_shift = imax(0, lw+lh-2) (size-dependent), implemented in stb_av1_reconstruct_block
Added inverse transform size shift: inv_shift = imin(lw,1) + imin(lh,1), applied after 2D transform
Both shifts match dav1d recon_tmpl.c formulas
history.outcome: Dequant and transform shifts implemented per AV1 spec and dav1d. PSNR ~10.5dB against dav1d reference. Pixel output still wrong — root cause is NOT in transforms or dequant math.

blockers: Pixel values are completely wrong (PSNR ~10.5dB, wrong colors) — issue is NOT in dequant/transform math which now matches dav1d formulas
CDF tables count entries get overwritten by memcpy (ICDF values written to count positions instead of 0, corrupting adaptation rates for ALL CDF-coded symbols)
Chroma U/V blocks bypass reconstruct_block entirely — raw coefficient tokens added to prediction pixels without dequant or inverse transform (line ~4140)
MSAC-based frame header uses local copy, losing CDF adaptations for tile decoder — should share MSAC state like dav1d does
CDF tables may have byte-order issues (2258-entry linear data vs struct field layout mismatch)
